author: terrible6
quote:
Oof, rough start in Vice City?
Whether you're genuinely hate-playing it or just joining the massive wave of 0/10 user reviews flooding Metacritic right now, there's definitely a massive divide since it launched on Thursday. Critics are handing out 10/10s like candy, while plenty of players are furious over the 30fps cap on consoles, the lack of a PC port at launch, or GTA+ content creeping into single-player.
What's got you giving it a zero—performance issues, story, or just trolling?
